Miss Yonge is much obliged to [Miss Alcock](/person/19) for her paper on the [Ladies Home](/organisation/191) which answers a question newly arrived from a correspondent.


[^1]: Black-edged paper and envelope postmarked Winchester C Jy 4 67, addressed to “Miss Alcock/39 Green Street/Grosvenor Square/London W”.
